items.q: How does the personalized service work?
items.a: After filling out the form, a dedicated consultant will get in touch within 24 hours. You'll receive one-on-one assistance with detailed information on floor plans, pricing, payment terms, and scheduling an in-person visit to the residential development.

Absolutely! We offer full support for bank financing. We work with the leading banks in the market, and our team assists you through the entire process — from the initial simulation to credit approval — ensuring the best terms for you.

items.q: What documents do I need to visit the residential development?
items.a: To schedule a visit, simply fill out the form with your details. For the in-person visit, we recommend bringing a photo ID. Our consultant will contact you to confirm the best time and meeting point.

items.q: Is the service exclusive to this residential development?
items.a: Yes, you'll have a dedicated consultant who knows every detail of this residential development. Our team is specialized and fully prepared to answer all your questions about the project, location, amenities, floor plans, and commercial terms.

items.q: Can I schedule an in-person visit?
items.a: Of course! After registering, our consultant will contact you to schedule a visit at the most convenient time for you. We offer guided in-person visits to the construction site or to the completed residential development, depending on the project's status.
